messages:
Maya: Quick check — vendor (Aurora Cloud) says APAC H100 pool should free up next week. We'd like to reserve 4 H100-80GB nodes for a Thu 20:00 PT demo canary. Who can own the quota/reserve request? :eyes:
Kevin: I can do the quota ticket but need the exact project/cost center + preferred zone. Also, is this for Dedicated or burst? If Dedicated we need a procurement amendment.
Maya: It's burst/demo (not Dedicated). Project: redwood-demo-apac, cost center: infra-grows. Preferred zone: asia-southeast1-a. Ticket template I used:
```bash
# terraform request snippet
resource "vendor_capacity_request" "h100_reserve" {
  project = "redwood-demo-apac"
  instance_type = "h100-80gb"
  count = 4
  start_time = "2026-03-26T03:00:00Z"
  end_time = "2026-03-27T03:00:00Z"
  note = "Canary/demo — reserved for product demo; contact maya@redwood.com"
}
```
Kevin: Thanks — I'll open ticket and ping vendor. Will post the ticket link here.
vendor-liaison: Confirmed on vendor portal, tentative hold placed. Portal ref: https://vendor.example.com/holds/ABC-4321. Please confirm ETA for delivery and whether preemptible is involved.
Maya: Thanks! ETA vendor said 2026-03-25 EOD for confirmation. Not preemptible — requested dedicated burst. 
Raj: Quick infra question — does the autoscaler we've been testing support mixing A100/H100 in the same pool? If not we should request pure H100 nodes.
Kevin: Not reliably — mix can cause packing inefficiencies. Recommend pure H100 pool for the canary. I'll add that to the ticket.
Sasha: I'm on the demo squad; if this is Thurs 20:00 PT I need to swap oncall that evening. @infra-oncall-bot can you note the shift? :wave:
infra-oncall-bot: [automated] Oncall swap request created — ticket #ONC-998. Please update rotation: Sasha out 2026-03-26 19:00-23:00 PT, Maya covering. 
Maya: Yup I'll cover the oncall window. Kevin — PR for the TF change?
Kevin: PR: https://git.internal.redwood.com/infra/terraform/pulls/734 — includes the vendor hold resource and Terraform var updates. Please review; lightweight change.
Sasha: Reviewed, left 1 nit. :thumbsup:
Maya: Approved. Can we close loop once vendor confirms? 
Kevin: Will update here after vendor confirms and once quota is provisioned.
vendor-liaison: Vendor updated: hold confirmed, nodes provisioned to staging, SSH keys pending. ETA for key injection: 2026-03-25 22:00 UTC.
Maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
